scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pi-science/contracts build && pnpm --filter @pi-science/server build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --parallel --filter @pi-science/contracts --filter @pi-science/server --filter frontend run test --maxWorkers=2 && pnpm test:skills
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pi-science/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @pi-science/server typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
